steps: Run: pnpm add @tiptap/react @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-link @tiptap/pm
Verify packages are added to package.json
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create template server actions for CRUD operations
steps: Create src/app/educator/templates/actions.ts with 'use server' directive
Define createTemplateSchema with Zod: name (string, min 1), subject (string, min 1), body (string, min 1)
Implement createTemplateAction(formData) - validates, gets educatorId from session, calls createTemplate service, revalidates path
Define updateTemplateSchema extending createTemplateSchema
Implement updateTemplateAction(id, formData) - validates ownership, updates via service, revalidates path
Implement deleteTemplateAction(id) - checks ownership, checks if in use via isTemplateInUse, deletes via service, revalidates path
Implement duplicateTemplateAction(id) - gets template, creates copy with '(Copia)' suffix in name
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create Tiptap rich text editor component
steps: Create src/components/educator/templates/template-editor.tsx
Import useEditor, EditorContent from @tiptap/react
Import StarterKit from @tiptap/starter-kit
Import Link extension from @tiptap/extension-link
Define TemplateEditorProps: { content: string, onChange: (html: string) => void, placeholder?: string }
Configure editor with StarterKit (bold, italic, bulletList, orderedList) and Link extension
Create toolbar with buttons: Bold, Italic, Bullet List, Ordered List, Link
Style toolbar and editor content area with Tailwind (border, padding, min-height)
Handle onChange to emit HTML content on editor updates
Export component as default
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create variable inserter component for template variables
steps: Create src/components/educator/templates/variable-inserter.tsx
Import AVAILABLE_VARIABLES from @/lib/email/template-variables
Import DropdownMenu components from @/components/ui/dropdown-menu
Import Button from @/components/ui/button
Define VariableInserterProps: { onInsert: (variable: string) => void }
Create dropdown menu with trigger button labeled 'Insertar variable'
Map AVAILABLE_VARIABLES to DropdownMenuItems showing variable key and description
On item click, call onInsert with the full variable syntax e.g. '{{studentName}}'
Style with appropriate icons (e.g., Variable or Braces icon from lucide-react)
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create template preview component with sample data
steps: Create src/components/educator/templates/template-preview.tsx
Import renderTemplate, TemplateVariables from @/lib/email/template-variables
Define SAMPLE_VARIABLES constant with example data for all variables
Define TemplatePreviewProps: { subject: string, body: string }
Create component that renders subject and body with SAMPLE_VARIABLES applied
Use Card component for preview container with 'Preview' header
Render subject in a styled header area
Render body HTML safely using dangerouslySetInnerHTML inside a prose-styled container
Add subtle styling to differentiate preview from edit area (background color, border)
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create template form component combining all elements
steps: Create src/components/educator/templates/template-form.tsx
Import useForm from react-hook-form with zodResolver
Import Input, Button, Label from shadcn/ui components
Import TemplateEditor, VariableInserter, TemplatePreview components
Define templateFormSchema with Zod: name, subject, body (all required strings)
Define TemplateFormProps: { defaultValues?, onSubmit: (data) => Promise<void>, isLoading?: boolean }
Create form with fields: Name (Input), Subject (Input with VariableInserter), Body (TemplateEditor with VariableInserter)
Add ref to editor to enable inserting variables at cursor position
Create two-column layout: left side form, right side TemplatePreview (on larger screens)
Wire up form submission to onSubmit prop
Show loading state on submit button
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create templates list page with table and actions
steps: Create src/app/educator/templates/page.tsx as async Server Component
Import getTemplatesByEducator from @/services/email-template-service
Import getCurrentUser helper to get session/educatorId
Import Table, TableHeader, TableRow, TableCell from shadcn/ui
Import Button, Link components
Fetch templates for current educator
Create page header with title 'Plantillas de Email' and 'Crear plantilla' button linking to /educator/templates/create
Create table with columns: Nombre, Asunto, Fecha creacion, Acciones
Add action buttons per row: Editar (link), Duplicar (button), Eliminar (button with confirmation dialog)
Create client component for delete action with AlertDialog confirmation
Handle empty state with message and CTA to create first template
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck
Create src/app/educator/templates/create/page.tsx as Server Component wrapper
Create src/app/educator/templates/create/create-template-client.tsx as Client Component
Import TemplateForm component
Import createTemplateAction from actions
Import useRouter from next/navigation for redirect after success
Import toast from sonner for success/error feedback
Implement form submission: call createTemplateAction, show toast, redirect to /educator/templates on success
Add page header with title 'Crear Plantilla' and back link to /educator/templates
Handle and display validation errors from server action

Verify with pnpm typecheck
Create src/app/educator/templates/[id]/edit/page.tsx as async Server Component
Import getTemplateById from @/services/email-template-service
Fetch template data, handle not found with notFound()
Create src/app/educator/templates/[id]/edit/edit-template-client.tsx as Client Component
Pass template data as defaultValues to TemplateForm
Import updateTemplateAction from actions
Implement form submission: call updateTemplateAction with template id, show toast, redirect on success
Add page header with title 'Editar Plantilla' and template name
Add back link to /educator/templates
